en.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
en.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
en.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
en.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
en.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
en.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
en.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
en.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
en.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
en.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
en.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
en.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
en.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
en.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
en.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
en.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
en.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
en.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
en.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
en.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
en.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
en.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
en.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
en.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
en.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
en.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
en.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
en.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
en.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
en.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
en.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
en.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
en.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
en.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
en.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
en.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
en.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
en.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
en.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
en.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
en.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
en.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

sq.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
sq.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sq.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sq.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sq.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
sq.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
sq.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
sq.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sq.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
sq.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sq.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
sq.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
sq.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
sq.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
sq.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
sq.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sq.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
sq.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
sq.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
sq.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sq.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
sq.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
sq.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
sq.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sq.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
sq.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
sq.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
sq.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sq.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.

am.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: ነጻ ጥቂት የዕድሜ ልክ ቅኝቶችን ያካትታል። Premium ለማየት በማንኛውም ጊዜ አክሊሉን ይንኩ።

am.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: መካከለኛው የካሜራ አዝራር ስካነሩን ከመተግበሪያው በማንኛውም ቦታ ይከፍታል።
am.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ታሪክዎ

am.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: ደርድር እና አጣራ
am.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: በታሪክ ውስጥ፣ በቀን፣ በስም፣ በእምነት ወይም በአይነት ለመደርደር ማጣሪያውን ይጠቀሙ።
am.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ባጆችን ያግኙ
am.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ድንጋዮችን ይለዩ፣ ተከታታይነት ይገንቡ እና ባጆችን ለመክፈት አይነቶችን ያስሱ።
am.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: ዝግጁ ነዎት
am.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: የመጀመሪያ ድንጋይዎን ይያዙ እና ስብስብዎን መገንባት ይጀምሩ።

am.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
am.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
am.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
am.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
am.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
am.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
am.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
am.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
am.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
am.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
am.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
am.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
am.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
am.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
am.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
am.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
am.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
am.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
am.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
am.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
am.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
am.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
am.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
am.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
am.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
am.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
am.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
am.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
am.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
am.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
am.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
am.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
am.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
am.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
am.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
am.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
am.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
am.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
am.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
am.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
am.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
am.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

ar.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ar.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ar.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ar.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ar.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ar.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ar.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ar.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ar.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ar.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ar.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ar.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ar.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ar.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ar.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ar.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ar.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ar.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ar.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ar.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ar.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ar.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ar.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ar.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ar.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ar.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ar.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ar.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ar.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ar.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ar.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ar.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ar.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ar.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ar.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ar.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ar.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ar.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ar.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ar.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ar.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
ar.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

hy.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
hy.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
hy.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
hy.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
hy.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
hy.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
hy.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
hy.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. hy.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
hy.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
hy.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
hy.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
hy.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
hy.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
hy.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
hy.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
hy.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
hy.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
hy.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
hy.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
hy.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
hy.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
hy.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
hy.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
hy.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
hy.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
hy.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property

hy.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
hy.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.

as.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
as.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
as.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
as.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
as.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
as.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
as.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
as.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
as.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
as.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
as.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
as.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
as.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
as.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
as.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
as.legal.terms.s4.body:

az.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
az.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
az.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
az.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
az.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
az.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
az.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
az.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.

az.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
az.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
az.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
az.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
az.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions

• Use the App only for lawful purposes

eu.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
eu.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
eu.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
eu.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
eu.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
eu.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
eu.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
eu.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
eu.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
eu.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
eu.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
eu.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
eu.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
eu.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
eu.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
eu.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
eu.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
eu.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
eu.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
eu.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
eu.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
eu.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
eu.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
eu.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
eu.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
eu.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
eu.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
eu.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
eu.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
eu.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
eu.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
eu.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
eu.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
eu.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
eu.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
eu.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
eu.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
eu.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
eu.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

bn.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: আপনার প্রোফাইল
bn.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ব্যাজ, সেটিংস, ভাষা এবং Clay বা Classic চেহারার জন্য প্রোফাইল খুলুন।
bn.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: সাজান ও ফিল্টার করুন
bn.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ইতিহাসে ফিল্টার দিয়ে তারিখ, নাম, আস্থা বা ধরন অনুসারে সাজান।
bn.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ব্যাজ অর্জন করুন
bn.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: পাথর শনাক্ত করুন, ধারা তৈরি করুন এবং ধরন অন্বেষণ করে ব্যাজ আনলক করুন।

bn.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
bn.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
bn.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
bn.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
bn.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
bn.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
bn.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
bn.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
bn.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
bn.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
bn.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
bn.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
bn.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
bn.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
bn.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
bn.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
bn.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
bn.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
bn.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
bn.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
bn.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
bn.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
bn.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
bn.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
bn.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
bn.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
bn.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
bn.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
bn.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
bn.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
bn.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
bn.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
bn.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
bn.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
bn.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
bn.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
bn.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
bn.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
bn.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
bn.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

bs.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
bs.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
bs.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
bs.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
bs.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
bs.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
bs.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
bs.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
bs.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
bs.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
bs.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
bs.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
bs.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
bs.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
bs.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
bs.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
bs.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
bs.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
bs.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
bs.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
bs.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
bs.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
bs.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
bs.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
bs.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
bs.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
bs.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
bs.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
bs.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
bs.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
bs.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
bs.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
bs.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
bs.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
bs.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
bs.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
bs.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
bs.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
bs.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
bs.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
bs.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
bs.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

my.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ဓါတ်ပုံရိုက်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် တင်သွင်းရန် ရော့ခ်ဖမ်းယူပါကို နှိပ်ပြီး ဉာဏ်ရည်တု ခွဲခြားသတ်မှတ်ချက်ကို ရယူပါ ။
my.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: အခမဲ့ Scan ဖတ် & ပရီမီယံ Premium
my.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: Free မှာ Lifetime Scanner အနည်းငယ်ပါဝင်ပါတယ် ။ ပရီမီယံကိုကြည့်ရန် သရဖူကို အချိန်မရွေး နှိပ်ပါ ။ Premium

my.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: စင်တာကင်မရာခလုတ်သည်အက်ပလီကေးရှင်းရှိမည်သည့်နေရာမှမဆိုစကင်နာကိုဖွင့်သည် ။
my.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: သင် ၏ သမိုင်းကြောင်း
my.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: သမိုင်းသည် ခွဲခြားသိမြင်မှုတိုင်းကို ထိန်းသိမ်းထားသည် — ရှာဖွေခြင်း ၊ စီစဉ်ခြင်းနှင့် အကြိုက်ဆုံးနမူနာများ ။

my.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: တံဆိပ်များ ၊ ဆက်တင်များ ၊ ဘာသာစကားနှင့် ရွှံ့နွံ သို့မဟုတ် ဂန္ထဝင်အသွင်အပြင်အတွက် ပရိုဖိုင်ကို ဖွင့်ပါ ။ Clay Classic

my.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
my.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
my.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
my.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
my.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
my.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
my.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
my.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
my.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
my.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
my.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
my.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
my.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
my.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
my.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
my.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
my.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
my.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
my.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
my.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
my.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
my.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
my.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
my.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
my.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
my.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
my.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
my.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
my.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
my.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
my.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
my.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
my.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
my.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
my.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
my.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
my.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
my.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
my.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
my.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
my.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
my.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

ca.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ca.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ca.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ca.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ca.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ca.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ca.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ca.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ca.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ca.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ca.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ca.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ca.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ca.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ca.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ca.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ca.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ca.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ca.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ca.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ca.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ca.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ca.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ca.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ca.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ca.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ca.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ca.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ca.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ca.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ca.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ca.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ca.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ca.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ca.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ca.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ca.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ca.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ca.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ca.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ca.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
ca.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

zh-Hans.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
zh-Hans.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
zh-Hans.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai
