zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
zh-Hant.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
zh-Hant.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

cs.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
cs.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
cs.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
cs.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
cs.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
cs.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
cs.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
cs.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
cs.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
cs.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
cs.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
cs.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
cs.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
cs.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
cs.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
cs.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
cs.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
cs.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
cs.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
cs.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
cs.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
cs.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
cs.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
cs.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
cs.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
cs.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
cs.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
cs.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
cs.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
cs.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
cs.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
cs.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
cs.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
cs.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
cs.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
cs.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.

cs.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

nl.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
nl.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
nl.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
nl.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
nl.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
nl.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
nl.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
nl.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
nl.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
nl.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
nl.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
nl.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
nl.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
nl.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
nl.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
nl.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
nl.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
nl.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
nl.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
nl.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
nl.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
nl.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
nl.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
nl.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
nl.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
nl.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
nl.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
nl.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
nl.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
nl.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
nl.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
nl.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
nl.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
nl.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
nl.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
nl.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
nl.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
nl.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
nl.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
nl.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
nl.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
nl.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

et.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
et.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
et.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
et.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
et.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
et.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
et.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
et.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
et.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
et.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
et.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
et.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
et.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
et.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
et.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
et.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
et.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
et.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
et.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
et.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
et.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
et.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
et.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
et.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
et.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
et.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
et.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
et.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
et.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
et.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
et.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
et.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
et.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.

On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection

ka.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: Ისტორიაში გამოიყენეთ ფილტრი თარიღის, სახელის, ნდობის ან ტიპის მიხედვით დასალაგებლად.

ka.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ka.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ka.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ka.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ka.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ka.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ka.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ka.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ka.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ka.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ka.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ka.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ka.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ka.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ka.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ka.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ka.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ka.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ka.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ka.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ka.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ka.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ka.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ka.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ka.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ka.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ka.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ka.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ka.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ka.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ka.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ka.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ka.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ka.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ka.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ka.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ka.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ka.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ka.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ka.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ka.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us

gu.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
gu.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
gu.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
gu.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
gu.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
gu.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
gu.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
gu.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
gu.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
gu.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
gu.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
gu.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
gu.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
gu.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
gu.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
gu.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
gu.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
gu.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
gu.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
gu.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
gu.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
gu.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
gu.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
gu.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
gu.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
gu.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
gu.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
gu.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
gu.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
gu.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
gu.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
gu.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
gu.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
gu.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
gu.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
gu.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
gu.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
gu.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
gu.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
gu.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

ht.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ht.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ht.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ht.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ht.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ht.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ht.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ht.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ht.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ht.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ht.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ht.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ht.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ht.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ht.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ht.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ht.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ht.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ht.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ht.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ht.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ht.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ht.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ht.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ht.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ht.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ht.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ht.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ht.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ht.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ht.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ht.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ht.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

he.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
he.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
he.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
he.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
he.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
he.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
he.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
he.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
he.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
he.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
he.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
he.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
he.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
he.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
he.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
he.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
he.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
he.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
he.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
he.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
he.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
he.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
he.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
he.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
he.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
he.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
he.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
he.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
he.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
he.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
he.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
he.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
he.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
he.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
he.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
he.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
he.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
he.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
he.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
he.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
he.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
he.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

hi.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
hi.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
hi.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
hi.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
hi.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
hi.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
hi.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
hi.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
hi.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
hi.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
hi.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
hi.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
hi.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
hi.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
hi.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
hi.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
hi.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
hi.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
hi.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
hi.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
hi.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
hi.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
hi.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
hi.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
hi.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
hi.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
hi.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
hi.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
hi.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
hi.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
hi.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
hi.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
hi.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
hi.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

hi.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law

is.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
is.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
is.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
is.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
is.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
is.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
is.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
is.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
is.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
is.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
is.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
is.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
is.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
is.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
is.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
is.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
is.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
is.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
is.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
is.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
is.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
is.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
is.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
is.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
is.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
is.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
is.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
is.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
is.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
is.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
is.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
is.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
is.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
is.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
is.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
is.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
is.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
is.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
is.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
is.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

ig.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ig.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ig.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ig.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ig.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ig.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ig.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ig.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ig.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ig.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ig.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ig.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ig.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ig.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ig.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ig.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ig.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ig.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ig.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ig.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ig.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ig.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ig.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ig.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ig.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ig.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ig.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ig.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ig.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ig.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ig.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ig.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ig.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ig.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ig.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ig.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ig.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ig.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

ga.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ga.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ga.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ga.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ga.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ga.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ga.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ga.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ga.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ga.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ga.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ga.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ga.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ga.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ga.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ga.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ga.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ga.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ga.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ga.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ga.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ga.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ga.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ga.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ga.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ga.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ga.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ga.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ga.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ga.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ga.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ga.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ga.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ga.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ga.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ga.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

ja.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ja.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ja.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ja.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ja.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ja.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ja.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ja.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ja.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ja.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ja.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ja.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ja.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ja.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ja.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ja.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ja.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ja.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ja.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ja.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ja.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ja.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ja.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ja.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ja.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ja.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ja.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ja.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ja.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ja.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ja.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ja.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ja.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ja.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ja.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ja.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ja.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ja.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ja.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ja.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ja.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
