jv.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
jv.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
jv.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
jv.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
jv.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
jv.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
jv.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
jv.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
jv.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
jv.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
jv.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
jv.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
jv.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
jv.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
jv.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
jv.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
jv.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
jv.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
jv.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
jv.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
jv.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
jv.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
jv.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
jv.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
jv.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
jv.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
jv.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
jv.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
jv.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
jv.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
jv.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
jv.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
jv.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
jv.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
jv.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
jv.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
jv.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
jv.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
jv.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
jv.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
jv.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
jv.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

kn.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: ಮನೆಗೆ ಸುಸ್ವಾಗತ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: ಇದು ಮನೆ — ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೂಲ.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ಬಂಡೆಯನ್ನು ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ಫೋಟೋ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅಥವಾ ಆಮದು ಮಾಡಲು ಮತ್ತು AI ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಚರ್ ರಾಕ್ ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: ಉಚಿತ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ Premium
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: ಉಚಿತವು ಕೆಲವು ಜೀವಮಾನದ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ನೋಡಲು ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದರೂ ಕಿರೀಟವನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ. Premium
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: ಕ್ವಿಕ್ ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: ಸೆಂಟರ್ ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ ಬಟನ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದಲಾದರೂ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನರ್ ಅನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಇತಿಹಾಸ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: ಇತಿಹಾಸವು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ — ಹುಡುಕಾಟ, ವಿಂಗಡಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾದರಿಗಳು.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ಬ್ಯಾಡ್ಜ್‌ಗಳು, ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳು, ಭಾಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಲೇ ಅಥವಾ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್ ಗೋಚರತೆಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ. Clay Classic
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಮಾಡಿ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ, ದಿನಾಂಕ, ಹೆಸರು, ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ ಅಥವಾ ಟೈಪ್ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಲು ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಬಳಸಿ.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ಬ್ಯಾಡ್ಜ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ಬ್ಯಾಡ್ಜ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್‌ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಂಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೈಕ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್‌ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: ನೀವು ಸಿದ್ಧರಿದ್ದೀರಿ
kn.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೊದಲ ಬಂಡೆಯನ್ನು ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ.

kn.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
kn.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
kn.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
kn.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
kn.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
kn.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
kn.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
kn.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
kn.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
kn.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
kn.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
kn.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
kn.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
kn.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
kn.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
kn.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
kn.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
kn.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
kn.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
kn.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
kn.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
kn.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
kn.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
kn.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
kn.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
kn.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
kn.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
kn.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
kn.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
kn.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
kn.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
kn.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
kn.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
kn.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
kn.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
kn.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
kn.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
kn.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms

kk.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: Сұрыптау және сүзгі

kk.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: Белгілер алыңыз
kk.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: Тастарды анықтаңыз, сериялар құрыңыз және түрлерді зерттеп белгілерді ашыңыз.
kk.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: Сіз дайынсыз
kk.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: Алғашқы тасыңызды түсіріп, коллекцияңызды жинай бастаңыз.

km.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: ស្វាគមន៍​ការ​មក​ដល់​ផ្ទះ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: នេះគឺជាទំព័រដើម - មូលដ្ឋានរបស់អ្នកសម្រាប់ការកំណត់អត្តសញ្ញាណដុំថ្ម និងមើលការរកឃើញថ្មីៗ ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ចាប់យកដុំថ្ម
km.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ចុចលើ Capture Rock ដើម្បីថត ឬនាំចូលរូបថត និងទទួលបានអត្តសញ្ញាណ AI ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: ការស្កេនដោយឥតគិតថ្លៃ & បុព្វលាភ Premium
km.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: Free រួមបញ្ចូលទាំងការស្កេនពេញមួយជីវិតមួយចំនួន ។ ប៉ះមកុដនៅពេលណាក៏បានដើម្បីមើលព្រីមៀម ។ Premium
km.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: កាមេរ៉ារហ័ស
km.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: ប៊ូតុងកាមេរ៉ាមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលបើកម៉ាស៊ីនស្កេនពីគ្រប់ទីកន្លែងនៅក្នុងកម្មវិធី ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ប្រវត្តិរបស់អ្នក
km.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: ប្រវត្តិសាស្រ្តរក្សារាល់ការកំណត់អត្តសញ្ញាណ — ការស្វែងរក តម្រៀប និងសំណាកដែលចូលចិត្ត ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: ទម្រង់របស់អ្នក
km.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: បើកប្រវត្តិរូបសម្រាប់ផ្លាកសញ្ញា ការកំណត់ ភាសា និងរូបរាងដីឥដ្ឋ ឬក្លាស៊ិក ។ Clay Classic
km.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: តម្រង តម្រៀប
km.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ក្នុង ប្រវត្តិ ប្រើ តម្រង ដើម្បី តម្រៀប តាម កាលបរិច្ឆេទ ឈ្មោះ ទំនុកចិត្ត ឬ ប្រភេទ & # 160; ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ទទួលបានផ្លាកសញ្ញា
km.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: កំណត់អត្តសញ្ញាណដុំថ្ម បង្កើតស្នាមប្រឡាក់ និងរុករកប្រភេទដើម្បីដោះសោផ្លាកសញ្ញា ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: អ្នកត្រៀមខ្លួនរួចរាល់ហើយ។
km.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: ចាប់យកដុំថ្មដំបូងរបស់អ្នក ហើយចាប់ផ្តើមកសាងការប្រមូលផ្តុំរបស់អ្នក ។

km.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
km.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
km.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
km.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
km.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
km.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
km.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
km.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
km.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
km.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
km.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
km.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
km.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
km.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
km.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
km.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
km.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
km.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
km.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
km.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
km.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
km.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
km.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
km.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
km.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
km.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
km.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
km.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
km.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
km.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
km.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
km.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
km.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
km.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
km.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
km.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
km.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
km.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
km.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms

ko.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ko.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ko.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ko.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ko.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ko.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ko.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ko.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ko.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ko.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ko.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ko.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ko.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ko.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ko.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ko.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ko.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ko.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ko.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ko.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ko.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ko.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ko.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ko.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ko.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ko.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ko.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ko.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.

ko.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.

ky.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: Таш тартыңыз
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: Сүрөткө тартуу же импорттоо жана ЖИ аныктоосун алуу үчүн Таш тартуу баскычын басыңыз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: Акысыз скандар жана Premium
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: Акысызда бир нече өмүрлүк скан бар. Premium көрүү үчүн каалаган убакта таажды басыңыз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: Тез камера
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: Ортодогу камера баскычы колдонмонун каалаган жеринен сканерди ачат.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: Тарыхыңыз
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: Тарых ар бир аныктоону сактайт — үлгүлөрдү издеңиз, иргөңүз жана сүйүктүүлөргө кошуңуз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: Профилиңиз
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: Белгилер, жөндөөлөр, тил жана Clay же Classic көрүнүшү үчүн Профилди ачыңыз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: Иргөө жана чыпкалоо
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: Тарыхта чыпка аркылуу күн, ат, ишенимдүүлүк же түр боюнча иргөңүз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: Белгилер алыңыз
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: Таштарды аныктаңыз, сериялар куруңуз жана түрлөрдү изилдеп белгилерди ачыңыз.
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: Сиз даярсыз
ky.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: Биринчи ташыңызды тартып, коллекцияңызды кура баштаңыз.

ky.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ky.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ky.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ky.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ky.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ky.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ky.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ky.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ky.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ky.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ky.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ky.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ky.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ky.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ky.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ky.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ky.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ky.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ky.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ky.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ky.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ky.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ky.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ky.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ky.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ky.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ky.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ky.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ky.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ky.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ky.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ky.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ky.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ky.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ky.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ky.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ky.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ky.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ky.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ky.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ky.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
ky.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

lo.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: ຍິນ ດີ ຕ້ອນ ຮັບ ສູ່ ບ້ານ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: ນີ້ແມ່ນ Home — ພື້ນຖານຂອງທ່ານ ສໍາ ລັບການ ກໍາ ນົດຫີນແລະເບິ່ງການຄົ້ນພົບຫຼ້າສຸດ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ຈັບກຸມກ້ອນຫີນ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ແຕະ Capture Rock ເພື່ອຖ່າຍຮູບຫລື ນໍາ ເຂົ້າຮູບພາບແລະໄດ້ຮັບໃບຢັ້ງຢືນ AI.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: ສະແກນຟຣີ & Premium
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: Free ມີບາງສະແກນຊີວິດ. ແຕະມຸງຄຸນທຸກເວລາເພື່ອເບິ່ງພຣີມຽມ. Premium
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: ກ້ອງຖ່າຍຮູບໄວ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: ປຸ່ມກ້ອງຖ່າຍຮູບສູນກາງເປີດເຄື່ອງສະແກນຈາກທຸກບ່ອນໃນແອັບ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ປະຫວັດຂອງທ່ານ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: ປະຫວັດສາດຮັກສາທຸກໆການ ກໍາ ນົດ — ການຄົ້ນຫາ, ການຈັດປະເພດ, ແລະຕົວຢ່າງທີ່ມັກ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: Profile ຂອງທ່ານ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ເປີດ Profile ສໍາລັບ badges, ການຕັ້ງຄ່າ, ພາສາ, ແລະ Clay or Classic ຫຼືລັກສະນະຄລາສສິກ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: ການຄັດເລືອກ & ກັ່ນຕອງ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ໃນປະຫວັດສາດ, ໃຊ້ກັ່ນຕອງເພື່ອຈັດປະເພດຕາມວັນທີ, ຊື່, ຄວາມ ຫມັ້ນ ໃຈ, ຫຼືປະເພດ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ໄດ້ຮັບປ້າຍ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ກຳນົດກ້ອນຫີນ, ສ້າງແຖວ, ແລະ ສຳຫຼວດປະເພດເພື່ອປົດລັອກປ້າຍ.
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: ທ່ານ ພອມພຽວ
lo.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: ຈັບກຸມຫີນທໍາອິດຂອງທ່ານແລະເລີ່ມຕົ້ນການກໍ່ສ້າງການເກັບກໍາຂອງທ່ານ.

lo.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
lo.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
lo.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
lo.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
lo.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
lo.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
lo.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
lo.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
lo.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
lo.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
lo.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
lo.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
lo.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
lo.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
lo.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
lo.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
lo.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
lo.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
lo.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
lo.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
lo.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
lo.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
lo.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
lo.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
lo.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
lo.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
lo.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
lo.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
lo.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
lo.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
lo.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
lo.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
lo.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
lo.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
lo.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
lo.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
lo.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
lo.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
lo.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
lo.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
lo.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
lo.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

lt.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
lt.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
lt.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
lt.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
lt.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
lt.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
lt.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
lt.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
lt.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
lt.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
lt.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
lt.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
lt.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
lt.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
lt.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
lt.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
lt.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
lt.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
lt.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
lt.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
lt.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
lt.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
lt.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
lt.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
lt.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
lt.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
lt.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
lt.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
lt.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
lt.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
lt.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
lt.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
lt.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
lt.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
lt.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
lt.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
lt.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
lt.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
lt.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
lt.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
lt.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
lt.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

mk.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
mk.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
mk.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
mk.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
mk.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
mk.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
mk.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
mk.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
mk.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
mk.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
mk.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
mk.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
mk.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
mk.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
mk.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
mk.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
mk.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
mk.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
mk.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
mk.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
mk.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
mk.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
mk.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
mk.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
mk.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
mk.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
mk.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
mk.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
mk.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
mk.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
mk.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.

mg.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
mg.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
mg.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
mg.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
mg.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
mg.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
mg.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
mg.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
mg.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
mg.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
mg.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
mg.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
mg.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
mg.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
mg.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
mg.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
mg.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
mg.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
mg.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
mg.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
mg.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
mg.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
mg.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
mg.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
mg.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
mg.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
mg.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
mg.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
mg.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
mg.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
mg.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
mg.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
mg.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
mg.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
mg.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
mg.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
mg.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
mg.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
mg.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
mg.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

ml.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ഒരു പാറ പിടിച്ചെടുക്കുക
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ഒരു ഫോട്ടോ എടുക്കാനോ ഇംപോർട്ട് ചെയ്യാനോ ഒരു AI ഐഡന്റിഫിക്കേഷൻ നേടാനോ ക്യാപ്ചർ റോക്ക് ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക.
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: സൗജന്യ സ്കാനുകളും പ്രീമിയവും Premium
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: സൗജന്യമായി കുറച്ച് ആജീവനാന്ത സ്കാനുകൾ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. പ്രീമിയം കാണുന്നതിന് എപ്പോൾ വേണമെങ്കിലും കിരീടത്തിൽ ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക. Premium
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: ക്വിക്ക് ക്യാമറ
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: സെന്റർ ക്യാമറ ബട്ടൺ ആപ്പിൽ എവിടെ നിന്നും സ്കാനർ തുറക്കുന്നു.
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: നിങ്ങളുടെ ചരിത്രം
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: തിരയൽ, അടുക്കൽ, പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട മാതൃകകൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെ എല്ലാ ഐഡന്റിഫിക്കേഷനും ചരിത്രം സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രൊഫൈൽ
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ബാഡ്ജുകൾ, ക്രമീകരണങ്ങൾ, ഭാഷ, കളിമണ്ണ് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ക്ലാസിക് രൂപങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയ്ക്കായി പ്രൊഫൈൽ തുറക്കുക. Clay Classic
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: ക്രമീകരിക്കുക & ഫിൽട്ടർ ചെയ്യുക
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ചരിത്രത്തിൽ, തീയതി, പേര്, ആത്മവിശ്വാസം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ടൈപ്പ് അനുസരിച്ച് അടുക്കാൻ ഫിൽട്ടർ ഉപയോഗിക്കുക.
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ബാഡ്ജുകൾ സമ്പാദിക്കുക
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ബാഡ്‌ജുകൾ അൺലോക്ക് ചെയ്യുന്നതിന് പാറകൾ തിരിച്ചറിയുക, സ്ട്രീക്കുകൾ നിർമ്മിക്കുക, തരങ്ങൾ പര്യവേക്ഷണം ചെയ്യുക.
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: നിങ്ങൾ തയ്യാറായിക്കഴിഞ്ഞു
ml.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: നിങ്ങളുടെ ആദ്യ പാറ പിടിച്ചെടുത്ത് നിങ്ങളുടെ ശേഖരം നിർമ്മിക്കാൻ ആരംഭിക്കുക.

ml.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ml.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ml.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ml.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ml.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ml.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ml.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ml.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ml.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ml.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ml.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ml.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ml.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ml.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ml.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ml.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ml.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ml.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ml.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ml.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ml.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ml.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ml.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ml.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ml.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ml.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ml.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ml.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ml.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ml.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ml.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ml.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ml.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ml.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ml.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ml.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ml.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ml.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

mt.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
mt.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
mt.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
mt.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
mt.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
mt.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
mt.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
mt.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
mt.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
mt.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
mt.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
mt.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
mt.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
mt.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
mt.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
mt.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
mt.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
mt.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
mt.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
mt.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
mt.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
mt.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
mt.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
mt.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
mt.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
mt.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
mt.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
mt.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
mt.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
mt.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
mt.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
mt.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
mt.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
mt.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
mt.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
mt.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
mt.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
mt.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
mt.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
mt.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
mt.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
mt.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai
