mi.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
mi.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
mi.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
mi.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
mi.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
mi.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
mi.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
mi.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
mi.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
mi.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
mi.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
mi.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
mi.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
mi.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
mi.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
mi.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
mi.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
mi.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
mi.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
mi.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
mi.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
mi.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
mi.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
mi.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
mi.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
mi.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
mi.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
mi.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
mi.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
mi.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
mi.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
mi.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
mi.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
mi.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
mi.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
mi.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
mi.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
mi.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
mi.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us

mn.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
mn.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
mn.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
mn.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
mn.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
mn.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
mn.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
mn.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
mn.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
mn.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
mn.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
mn.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
mn.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
mn.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
mn.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
mn.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
mn.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
mn.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
mn.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
mn.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
mn.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
mn.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
mn.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
mn.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
mn.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
mn.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
mn.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
mn.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
mn.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
mn.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
mn.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
mn.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
mn.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
mn.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
mn.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
mn.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
mn.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
mn.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
mn.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
mn.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
mn.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
mn.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

ne.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ne.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ne.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ne.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ne.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ne.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ne.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ne.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ne.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ne.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ne.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ne.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ne.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ne.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ne.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ne.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ne.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ne.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ne.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ne.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ne.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ne.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ne.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ne.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ne.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ne.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ne.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ne.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ne.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ne.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ne.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ne.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ne.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ne.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ne.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

ne.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law

or.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: ଘରକୁ ସ୍ୱାଗତ କରନ୍ତୁ
or.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: ଏହା ହେଉଛି ଘର — ପଥର ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଏବଂ ସାମ୍ପ୍ରତିକ ସନ୍ଧାନ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ଗୋଟିଏ ପଥର ଧାରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ
or.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ଏକ ଫଟୋ ନେବା କିମ୍ବା ଆମଦାନୀ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କ୍ୟାପଚର ରକକୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଏକ AI ପରିଚୟ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତ କରନ୍ତୁ ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: ମାଗଣା ସ୍କାନ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରିମିୟମ Premium
or.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: ଏଥିରେ କିଛି ଲାଇଫ ସ୍କାନ ମଧ୍ୟ ସାମିଲ ରହିଛି । ପ୍ରିମିୟମ୍ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଯେକୌଣସି ସମୟରେ ମୁକୁଟକୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ । Premium
or.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: ତ୍ୱରିତ କ୍ୟାମେରା
or.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: ସେଣ୍ଟର କ୍ୟାମେରା ବଟନ ଆପର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରୁ ସ୍କାନର ଖୋଲିବ ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଇତିହାସ
or.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: ଇତିହାସ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପରିଚୟକୁ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ କରିଥାଏ — ସନ୍ଧାନ, ସଜାଡ଼ିବା ଏବଂ ପ୍ରିୟ ନମୁନା ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: ଆପଣଙ୍କର ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲ
or.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ବ୍ୟାଜ, ସେଟିଙ୍ଗ, ଭାଷା, ଏବଂ କ୍ଲାଏ କିମ୍ବା ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ । Clay Classic
or.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ (F)
or.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ଇତିହାସରେ, ତାରିଖ, ନାମ, ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ, କିମ୍ବା ପ୍ରକାର ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ସଜାଡ଼ିବା ପାଇଁ ଛାଣକକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ବ୍ୟାଜ ଉପାର୍ଜନ କରନ୍ତୁ
or.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ପଥରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପଥରକୁ ନିର୍ମାଣ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ବ୍ୟାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଖୋଲିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରକାରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅନ୍ୱେଷଣ କରନ୍ତୁ ।
or.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: ଆପଣ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଅଛନ୍ତି କି?
or.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: ତୁମର ପ୍ରଥମ ପଥର ଧର ଏବଂ ତୁମର ସଂଗ୍ରହ ନିର୍ମାଣ ଆରମ୍ଭ କର ।

or.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
or.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
or.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
or.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
or.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
or.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
or.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
or.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
or.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
or.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
or.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
or.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
or.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
or.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
or.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
or.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
or.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
or.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
or.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
or.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).

ps.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ps.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ps.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ps.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ps.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ps.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ps.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ps.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.

ps.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ps.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ps.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ps.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ps.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights

fa.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
fa.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
fa.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
fa.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
fa.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
fa.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
fa.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
fa.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
fa.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
fa.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
fa.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
fa.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
fa.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
fa.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
fa.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
fa.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
fa.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
fa.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
fa.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
fa.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
fa.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
fa.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
fa.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
fa.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
fa.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
fa.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
fa.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
fa.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
fa.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
fa.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
fa.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
fa.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
fa.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
fa.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
fa.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
fa.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
fa.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
fa.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
fa.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
fa.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
fa.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
fa.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

pa.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
pa.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
pa.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
pa.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
pa.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
pa.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
pa.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
pa.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
pa.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
pa.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
pa.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
pa.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
pa.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
pa.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
pa.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
pa.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
pa.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
pa.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
pa.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
pa.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
pa.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
pa.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
pa.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
pa.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
pa.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
pa.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
pa.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
pa.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
pa.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
pa.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
pa.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
pa.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
pa.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
pa.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
pa.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
pa.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
pa.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
pa.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
pa.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
pa.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

ro.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ro.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ro.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ro.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ro.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ro.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ro.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ro.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ro.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ro.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ro.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ro.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ro.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ro.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ro.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ro.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ro.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ro.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ro.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ro.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ro.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ro.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ro.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ro.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ro.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ro.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ro.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ro.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ro.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ro.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ro.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ro.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ro.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ro.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ro.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

ro.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ro.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ro.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms

sm.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sm.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
sm.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sm.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sm.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sm.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
sm.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
sm.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
sm.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sm.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
sm.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sm.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
sm.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
sm.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
sm.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
sm.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
sm.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sm.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
sm.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
sm.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
sm.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sm.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
sm.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
sm.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
sm.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sm.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
sm.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
sm.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
sm.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sm.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
sm.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
sm.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
sm.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sm.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
sm.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
sm.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
sm.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
sm.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
sm.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
sm.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
sm.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
sm.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

sr.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sr.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sr.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sr.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection

sr.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sr.legal.terms.s4.body:

sr.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security

sd.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sd.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
sd.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sd.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sd.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sd.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
sd.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
sd.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
sd.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sd.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
sd.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sd.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
sd.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
sd.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
sd.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
sd.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
sd.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sd.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
sd.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
sd.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
sd.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sd.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
sd.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
sd.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
sd.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sd.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
sd.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
sd.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
sd.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sd.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
sd.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
sd.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
sd.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sd.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
sd.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
sd.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
sd.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
sd.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
sd.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
sd.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
sd.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
sd.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

si.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: මෙය මුල් පිටුවයි — ගල් හඳුනා ගැනීමට සහ මෑත සොයාගැනීම් බැලීමට ඔබේ පදනම.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ගලක් ග්‍රහණය කරන්න
si.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ඡායාරූපයක් ගැනීමට හෝ ආනයනය කිරීමට සහ AI හඳුනාගැනීමක් ලබා ගැනීමට ගල ග්‍රහණය කරන්න තට්ටු කරන්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: නොමිලේ ස්කෑන් සහ Premium
si.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: නොමිලේ කිහිපයක ජීවිත කාලීන ස්කෑන් ඇත. Premium බැලීමට ඕනෝම වේලාවක කිරීටය තට්ටු කරන්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: ඉක්කමන් කැමරාව
si.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: මැද කැමරා බොත්තම යෙදුමේ ඕනෝම තැනකින් ස්කෑනරය විවෘත කරයි.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: ඔබේ ඉතිහාසය
si.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: ඉතිහාසය සෑම හඳුනාගැනීමක්ම තබයි — නියැදි සොයන්න, අනුපිළිවෙලට සකසන්න සහ ප්‍රියතම කරන්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: ඔබේ පැතිකඩ
si.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: ලාංඡන, සැකසුම්, භාෂාව සහ Clay හෝ Classic පෙනුම සඳහා පැතිකඩ විවෘත කරන්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: අනුපිළිවෙලට සැකසීම සහ පෙරහන
si.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: ඉතිහාසයේ පෙරහන භාවිතා කර දිනය, නම, විශ්වාසය හෝ වර්ගය අනුව අනුපිළිවෙලට සකසන්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: ලාංඡන උපයන්න
si.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: ගල් හඳුනා ගන්න, අනුක්‍රම ගොඩනගන්න සහ වර්ග ගවේෂණය කර ලාංඡන අගුළු හරින්න.
si.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: ඔබ සූදානම්
si.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: ඔබේ පළමු ගල ග්‍රහණය කර ඔබේ එකතුව ගොඩනැගීම ආරම්භ කරන්න.

si.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
si.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
si.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
si.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
si.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
si.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
si.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
si.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
si.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
si.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
si.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
si.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
si.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
si.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
si.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
si.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
si.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
si.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
si.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
si.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
si.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
si.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
si.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
si.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
si.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
si.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
si.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
si.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
si.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
si.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
si.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
si.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
si.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
si.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
si.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
si.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
si.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
si.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
si.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
si.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sk.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sk.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
sk.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sk.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sk.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sk.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
sk.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
sk.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
sk.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sk.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
sk.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sk.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
sk.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
sk.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
sk.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
sk.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
sk.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sk.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
sk.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
sk.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
sk.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sk.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
sk.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
sk.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
sk.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sk.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
sk.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
sk.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
sk.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sk.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
sk.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
sk.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
sk.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sk.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
sk.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
sk.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
sk.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
sk.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
sk.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
sk.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
sk.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
sk.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

so.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
so.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
so.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
so.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
so.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
so.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
so.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
so.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
so.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
so.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
so.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
so.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
so.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
so.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
so.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
so.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
so.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
so.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
so.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
so.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
so.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
so.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
so.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
so.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.

es.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
es.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
es.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
es.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).

• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
es.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services

es.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
