sw.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
sw.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
sw.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
sw.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
sw.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
sw.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
sw.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sw.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
sw.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sw.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
sw.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
sw.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
sw.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
sw.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
sw.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sw.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
sw.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
sw.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
sw.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
sw.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
sw.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
sw.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
sw.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sw.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
sw.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
sw.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
sw.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sw.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
sw.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
sw.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
sw.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sw.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.

tg.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: Хуш омадед ба асосӣ
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: Ин Асосӣ аст — пойгоҳи шумо барои муайян кардани сангҳо ва дидани ёфтҳои охирин.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: Сангро сабт кунед
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: Сангро Сабт Кунедро пахш кунед, то акс гиред ё ворид кунед ва муайянкунии AI гиред.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: Сканҳои ройгон & Premium
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: Ройгон чанд скани умрбод дорад. Барои дидани Premium ҳар вақт тоҷро пахш кунед.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: Камераи зуд
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: Тугмаи марказии камера сканерро аз ҳар ҷои барнома мекушояд.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: Таърихи шумо
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: Таърих ҳар муайянкуниро нигоҳ медорад — ҷустуҷӯ кунед, ҷудо кунед ва намунаҳоро дӯст доред.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: Профили шумо
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: Профилро барои нишонҳо, танзимот, забон ва намуди Clay ё Classic кушоед.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: Ҷудо & филтр
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: Дар Таърих, филтрро истифода баред, то аз рӯи сана, ном, эътимод ё намуд ҷудо кунед.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: Нишонҳо ба даст оред
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: Сангро муайян кунед, силсилаҳо созед ва намудҳоро омӯзед, то нишонҳоро кушоед.
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: Шумо омодаед
tg.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: Аввалин санги худро сабт кунед ва коллексияи худро оғоз кунед.

tg.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tg.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
tg.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
tg.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
tg.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
tg.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
tg.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
tg.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
tg.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
tg.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
tg.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
tg.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
tg.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
tg.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
tg.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
tg.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
tg.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
tg.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
tg.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
tg.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
tg.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
tg.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
tg.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
tg.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
tg.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
tg.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
tg.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
tg.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
tg.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
tg.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
tg.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
tg.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
tg.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
tg.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
tg.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
tg.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
tg.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
tg.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
tg.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
tg.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
tg.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
tg.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

ta.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: வீட்டிற்கு வரவேற்கிறோம்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: இது முகப்பு — பாறைகளை அடையாளம் காணவும் சமீபத்திய கண்டுபிடிப்புகளைப் பார்க்கவும் உங்கள் அடிப்படை.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ஒரு பாறையைப் படம்பிடிக்கவும்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: புகைப்படம் எடுக்க அல்லது இறக்குமதி செய்ய Capture Rock-ஐத் தட்டி AI அடையாளத்தைப் பெறுங்கள்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: இலவச ஸ்கேன்கள் & Premium
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: இலவசத்தில் சில வாழ்நாள் ஸ்கேன்கள் உள்ளன. Premium பார்க்க எப்போதும் கிரீடத்தைத் தட்டவும்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: விரைவு கேமரா
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: நடு கேமரா பொத்தான் செயலியில் எங்கிருந்தும் ஸ்கேனரைத் திறக்கும்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: உங்கள் வரலாறு
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: வரலாறு ஒவ்வொரு அடையாளத்தையும் வைத்திருக்கும் — மாதிரிகளைத் தேடுங்கள், வரிசைப்படுத்துங்கள், பிடித்தமாக்குங்கள்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: உங்கள் சுயவிவரம்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: பேட்ஜ்கள், அமைப்புகள், மொழி மற்றும் Clay அல்லது Classic தோற்றத்திற்கு Profile-ஐத் திறக்கவும்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: வரிசைப்படுத்தி வடிகட்டுங்கள்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: வரலாற்றில் தேதி, பெயர், நம்பிக்கை அல்லது வகைப்படி வரிசைப்படுத்த வடிப்பானைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: பேட்ஜ்களைப் பெறுங்கள்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: பாறைகளை அடையாளம் காணுங்கள், தொடர்களை உருவாக்குங்கள், பேட்ஜ்களைத் திறக்க வகைகளை ஆராயுங்கள்.
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: நீங்கள் தயாராக உள்ளீர்கள்
ta.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: உங்கள் முதல் பாறையைப் படம்பிடித்து உங்கள் தொகுப்பை உருவாக்கத் தொடங்குங்கள்.
ta.settings.replayOnboarding.subtitle: முதல் முறை அமைப்பை மீண்டும் பாருங்கள்

ta.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ta.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ta.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ta.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ta.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ta.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ta.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ta.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ta.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ta.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ta.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ta.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ta.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ta.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ta.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ta.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ta.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ta.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ta.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ta.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ta.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ta.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ta.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ta.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ta.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ta.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ta.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ta.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ta.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ta.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ta.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ta.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ta.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ta.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ta.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ta.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ta.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ta.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ta.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ta.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ta.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
ta.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

tt.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tt.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
tt.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
tt.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
tt.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
tt.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
tt.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
tt.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
tt.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
tt.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
tt.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
tt.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
tt.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
tt.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
tt.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
tt.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
tt.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
tt.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
tt.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
tt.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
tt.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
tt.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
tt.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
tt.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
tt.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
tt.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
tt.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
tt.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
tt.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
tt.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
tt.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
tt.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
tt.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
tt.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
tt.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
tt.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
tt.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
tt.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
tt.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
tt.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
tt.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
tt.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

te.onboarding.tutorial.gotIt: అర్థమైంది. మేము మీకు ఇటువంటి కథనాలు మరిన్నింటిని చూపుతాము.మీకు ఇష్టమైనవాటి గురించి మాకు మరింత తెలియజేయండి:
te.onboarding.tutorial.step1.title: ఇంటికి స్వాగతం
te.onboarding.tutorial.step1.body: ఇది హోమ్ — రాళ్లను గుర్తించడానికి మరియు ఇటీవల కనుగొన్న వాటిని చూడటానికి మీ ఆధారం.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step2.title: ఒక బండను పట్టుకోండి
te.onboarding.tutorial.step2.body: ఫోటో తీయడానికి లేదా దిగుమతి చేయడానికి మరియు AI గుర్తింపు పొందడానికి క్యాప్చర్ రాక్ ‌ ను తట్టండి.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step3.title: ఉచిత స్కాన్ ‌ లు & ప్రీమియం Premium
te.onboarding.tutorial.step3.body: ఉచితంగా కొన్ని జీవితకాల స్కాన్ ‌ లు ఉంటాయి. ప్రీమియం చూడటానికి ఎప్పుడైనా కిరీటాన్ని తట్టండి. Premium
te.onboarding.tutorial.step4.title: త్వరిత కెమెరా
te.onboarding.tutorial.step4.body: సెంటర్ కెమెరా బటన్ యాప్ ‌ లో ఎక్కడి నుండైనా స్కానర్ ‌ ను తెరుస్తుంది.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step5.title: మీ చరిత్ర
te.onboarding.tutorial.step5.body: చరిత్ర ప్రతి గుర్తింపును ఉంచుతుంది — శోధన, క్రమబద్ధీకరణ మరియు ఇష్టమైన నమూనాలు.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step6.title: మీ ప్రొఫైల్
te.onboarding.tutorial.step6.body: బ్యాడ్జ్ ‌ లు, సెట్టింగ్ ‌ లు, భాష మరియు క్లే లేదా క్లాసిక్ ప్రదర్శన కోసం ప్రొఫైల్ ‌ ను తెరవండి. Clay Classic
te.onboarding.tutorial.step7.title: క్రమబద్ధీకరణ & ఫిల్టర్
te.onboarding.tutorial.step7.body: చరిత్రలో, తేదీ, పేరు, విశ్వాసం లేదా రకం వారీగా క్రమబద్ధీకరించడానికి ఫిల్టర్ ‌ ను ఉపయోగించండి.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step8.title: బ్యాడ్జ్ ‌ లు సంపాదించండి
te.onboarding.tutorial.step8.body: బ్యాడ్జ్ ‌ లను అన్ ‌ లాక్ చేయడానికి రాళ్లను గుర్తించండి, స్ట్రీక్ ‌ లను నిర్మించండి మరియు రకాలను అన్వేషించండి.
te.onboarding.tutorial.step9.title: మీరు సిద్ధంగా ఉన్నారు
te.onboarding.tutorial.step9.body: మీ మొదటి రాయిని పట్టుకుని, మీ సేకరణను నిర్మించడం ప్రారంభించండి.

te.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
te.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
te.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
te.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
te.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
te.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
te.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
te.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
te.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
te.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
te.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
te.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
te.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
te.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
te.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
te.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
te.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
te.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
te.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
te.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
te.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
te.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
te.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
te.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
te.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
te.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
te.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
te.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
te.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
te.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
te.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
te.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
te.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
te.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
te.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
te.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
te.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
te.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
te.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
te.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
te.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

th.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
th.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
th.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
th.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
th.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
th.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
th.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
th.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
th.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
th.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
th.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
th.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
th.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
th.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
th.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
th.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
th.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
th.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
th.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
th.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
th.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
th.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
th.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
th.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
th.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
th.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
th.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
th.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
th.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
th.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
th.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
th.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
th.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
th.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

th.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law

tk.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tk.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
tk.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
tk.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
tk.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
tk.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
tk.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
tk.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
tk.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
tk.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
tk.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
tk.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
tk.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
tk.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
tk.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
tk.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
tk.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
tk.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
tk.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
tk.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
tk.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
tk.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
tk.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
tk.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
tk.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
tk.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
tk.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
tk.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
tk.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
tk.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
tk.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
tk.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
tk.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
tk.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
tk.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
tk.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
tk.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
tk.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
tk.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
tk.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
tk.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
tk.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

ug.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ug.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ug.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
ug.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
ug.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
ug.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
ug.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
ug.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
ug.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
ug.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
ug.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
ug.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
ug.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
ug.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
ug.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
ug.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
ug.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
ug.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
ug.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
ug.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
ug.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
ug.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
ug.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
ug.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
ug.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ug.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
ug.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
ug.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
ug.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ug.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
ug.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
ug.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
ug.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
ug.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
ug.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
ug.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
ug.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
ug.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
ug.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
ug.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
ug.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
ug.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

uz.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
uz.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
uz.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
uz.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
uz.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
uz.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
uz.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
uz.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
uz.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
uz.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
uz.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
uz.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
uz.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
uz.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
uz.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
uz.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
uz.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
uz.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
uz.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
uz.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
uz.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
uz.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
uz.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
uz.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
uz.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
uz.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
uz.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
uz.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
uz.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
uz.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
uz.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
uz.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
uz.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
uz.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
uz.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
uz.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
uz.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
uz.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
uz.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
uz.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
uz.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
uz.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

cy.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
cy.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
cy.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
cy.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
cy.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
cy.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
cy.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
cy.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
cy.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
cy.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
cy.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
cy.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
cy.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
cy.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
cy.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
cy.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
cy.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
cy.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
cy.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
cy.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
cy.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
cy.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
cy.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
cy.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
cy.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us

xh.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
xh.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
xh.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
xh.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
xh.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
xh.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
xh.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
xh.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
xh.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
xh.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
xh.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
xh.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
xh.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
xh.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
xh.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
xh.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
xh.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
xh.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
xh.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
xh.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
xh.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
xh.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
xh.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
xh.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
xh.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
xh.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
xh.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
xh.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
xh.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
xh.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
xh.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
xh.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
xh.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
xh.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
xh.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
xh.legal.terms.s8.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to the App for violations of these Terms.
xh.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
xh.legal.terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
xh.legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
xh.legal.terms.s10.body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
xh.legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Contact Us
xh.legal.terms.s11.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact: support@geolens.ai

yo.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
yo.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
yo.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
yo.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
yo.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
yo.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
yo.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
yo.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
yo.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
yo.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
yo.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
yo.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
yo.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
yo.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
yo.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
yo.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
yo.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
yo.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
yo.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
yo.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
yo.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
yo.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
yo.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
yo.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
