zu.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
zu.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
zu.legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
zu.legal.privacy.s1.body: GeoLens ("the App," "we," "us") is an AI-powered rock identification application. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it's used, and what choices you have.
zu.legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
zu.legal.privacy.s2.body:
On-Device Data (never leaves your device):
• Photos you take of rocks/minerals for identification
• Your identification history and saved rock collection
• App preferences and settings

Data Sent Off-Device (via API requests):
When the App needs the AI model to identify a rock, the photo (or data extracted from it) is sent to our identification service/API to generate a result.
Basic technical data may be sent to keep the API request working correctly, such as:
• App version
• Device operating system type
• A randomly generated request ID (not tied to your name or personal identity)

We do not collect your name, email, contacts, or precise real-time location unless you explicitly choose to add location tags to a rock entry, and even then, that stays on-device unless you choose to share it (e.g., via export or social sharing).
zu.legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How We Use Information
zu.legal.privacy.s3.body:
• To identify rocks and minerals using AI image recognition
• To improve the accuracy of the identification model (only using anonymized data, if applicable)
• To fix bugs and maintain app performance
zu.legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
zu.legal.privacy.s4.body: The App may use a third-party AI/API provider to process identification requests. These providers only receive the minimum data necessary to return a result and are contractually/technically required to handle it securely. We do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
zu.legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
zu.legal.terms.s1.body: By downloading, installing, or using GeoLens, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
zu.legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Description of Service
zu.legal.terms.s2.body: GeoLens uses AI/machine learning to help identify rocks and minerals from photos you provide. Identification results are estimates based on AI analysis and may not always be 100% accurate.
zu.legal.terms.s3.title: 3. No Professional Advice
zu.legal.terms.s3.body:
GeoLens is intended for educational and hobbyist purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional geological, mineralogical, or safety analysis. Do not rely on the App for:
• Determining the safety of handling or ingesting a substance
• Commercial valuation of gems/minerals
• Legal, medical, or safety-critical decisions
zu.legal.terms.s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
zu.legal.terms.s4.body:
You agree to:
• Use the App only for lawful purposes
• Not attempt to reverse-engineer, hack, or misuse the AI identification service
• Not upload photos containing illegal content or content that violates others' rights
zu.legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
zu.legal.privacy.s5.body:
• Most of your data (photos, history, collection) is stored locally on your device.
• Data sent to our API for processing is transmitted using encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
• We retain API request data only as long as necessary to return your result, then delete it, unless otherwise required by law.
zu.legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
zu.legal.privacy.s6.body: GeoLens does not knowingly collect personal information from children beyond what's needed to operate the app (like a photo submitted for identification). We do not require account creation with personal details. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided personal information beyond this, contact us using the information in Section 9.
zu.legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Choices & Rights
zu.legal.privacy.s7.body:
Depending on your location (e.g., under GDPR in the EU/UK or CCPA in California), you may have rights to:
• Access the data associated with your requests
• Request deletion of data held by our API provider
• Opt out of any optional data-sharing features

Since most data stays on your device, deleting the App or clearing its data removes the vast majority of your information immediately.
zu.legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
zu.legal.privacy.s8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the App changes. We'll update the "Last Updated" date above when we do. Continued use of the App after changes means you accept the updated policy.
zu.legal.privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact Us
zu.legal.privacy.s9.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact: support@geolens.ai
zu.legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
zu.legal.terms.s5.body: The App, its design, code, and AI models are owned by GeoLens and its licensors. You retain ownership of the photos you take, but you grant us a limited license to process them (e.g., send them to our API) solely to provide the identification service.
zu.legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
zu.legal.terms.s6.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that identification results will always be accurate.
zu.legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
zu.legal.terms.s7.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, GeoLens and its developers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including reliance on identification results.
zu.legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Termination

zu.legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Governing Law
